feeding_claim.verbatim: 16 years ago we converted our 5th generation farm to raising 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef and lamb.

notes: Verifier 2026-11-15: read the about page, the grass-fed beef store page and the locations page. The about page says the farm converted to 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef and lamb; animals graze pasture and get farm-grown hay, alfalfa, sainfoin and grasses in winter. The store lists about 30 beef cuts, bundles and patties; no lamb products were listed even though a lamb category exists. The site delivers to communities in Northern Utah and Southeast Idaho, with home delivery by zip code; no pickup sites are named and no shipping is mentioned. Phone and PO Box 337, Soda Springs are on the site.
